title: Passage 11
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: It's always a good thing to have a hobby, such as collecting stamps or baking.
sentences.cn: 有爱好总是一件好事，比如集邮或者烘焙。

sentences.en: For Miss Patty, a school bus driver, her hobby of knitting has made her really touch the community.
sentences.cn: 帕蒂小姐是一名校车司机，她的编织爱好使她真正感动了社区。

sentences.en: Miss Patty always wanted to do something in her spare time to help the students.
sentences.cn: 帕蒂小姐总是想利用业余时间做点什么来帮助学生们。

sentences.en: After a conversation with one of the students, things took a turn from knitting one hat to knitting more hats.
sentences.cn: 与其中一个学生交谈之后，事情出现了转机，让她从编织一顶帽子变成了编织更多的帽子。

sentences.en: The boy in the school uniform gets on the bus, and he goes, 'What are you doing?'
sentences.cn: 一个穿着校服的男孩上了校车，他问：“你在做什么？”

sentences.en: He said, 'That would be great having such a warm hat in icy winter.'
sentences.cn: 他说：“在寒冷的冬天能有这样一顶暖和的帽子真是太好了。”

sentences.en: So I said, 'What colour would you like?'
sentences.cn: 于是我说：“你想要什么颜色呢？”

sentences.en: Miss Patty told the local newspaper.
sentences.cn: 帕蒂小姐告诉当地报纸。

sentences.en: Several years have passed since that day, and Miss Patty has already knitted 7,083 hats, along with some gloves for students.
sentences.cn: 自那天以来已经过去了好几年，帕蒂小姐已经为学生们织了7083顶帽子，还有一些手套。

sentences.en: Sometimes she will get the student's favourite colour before she begins the project.
sentences.cn: 有时开始编织之前，她会先询问学生们最喜欢的颜色。

sentences.en: What is more moving is that Miss Patty buys all the materials using her own cash.
sentences.cn: 更让人感动的是，帕蒂小姐都是用自己的钱购买所有材料。

sentences.en: Some people do give her gift cards around the Christmas holidays to help,
sentences.cn: 圣诞节假期前后，确实有人会送她礼品卡来帮助她，

sentences.en: but she still withdraws a lot of dollars from her own bank account.
sentences.cn: 但她仍然会从自己的银行账户中取出不少美元。

sentences.en: She also manages her time well to keep her kitchen and bedroom tidy and even to visit the local museum for inspiration.
sentences.cn: 她还把时间管理得很好，保持厨房和卧室的整洁，甚至也去当地博物馆寻找灵感。

sentences.en: Along with the charity act of making pretty hats for the students that will keep them warm,
sentences.cn: 除了为学生们编织能让他们保暖的漂亮帽子这一善举之外，

sentences.en: Miss Patty also gets praise for being a trusted friend to the students.
sentences.cn: 帕蒂小姐还因她是被学生们信赖的朋友而受到称赞。

sentences.en: Of course, the kids can buy hats from a store, but they always like hers better.
sentences.cn: 当然，孩子们可以从商店买到帽子，但他们总是更喜欢她做的帽子！
